title: From Thin Film to Battery: FIB-SIMS with TOF Technology for High Resolution Chemical Imaging
content: Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) is a technique used to analyze the chemical composition of solid materials. A primary ion beam sputters the surface at a microscopic level. The ejected secondary ions are then collected and analyzed by a mass spectrometer, providing detailed insights into the sample’s composition.[1] SIMS is a direct measurement method that enables the detection of all elements of the periodic table and differentiates between their isotopes.
